optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Aqinos Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} The ability to cast {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}} As a part of the {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to adopt this form, if you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 1st level or higher as your action, but no higher than half your Max Power Level, you can make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Ataru Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: As a part of the {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to adopt this form, you can leap up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Bakuuni Hand Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: As a part of the {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to adopt this form, if you took the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action and would be able to use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to make an unarmed strike, you can do so as a part of this {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

Until the start of your next turn, when a creature enters your reach or moves while within your reach, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to attempt to shove the creature. On a success, you can choose shove the target an additional 5 feet.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Djem So Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: Before the end of your next turn, you can add half your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of +1) to one {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} you make using Strength.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Drallig Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: Until the start of your next turn, you gain a special {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}. When a creature enters your reach or moves while within your reach, you can use this special {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to leap to an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} from that creature.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Ishu Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: If there is a friendly creature within 15 feet of you, you can move up to 10 feet without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}. You must end this movement within 5 feet of the friendly creature.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Jar'Kai Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: As a part of the {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to adopt this form, if you took the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action, you can engage in Double- or Two-Weapon Fighting.
Each time you hit with an attack on this turn, you can move up to 5 feet without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} from the creature you hit.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Juyo Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: Until the start of your next turn, your {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} range with weapons increases by 1.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Makashi Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: Until the start of your next turn, you gain a special {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}. When a creature makes a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against you and misses, you can use this special {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack} against that creature.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Niman Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: As a part of the {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to adopt this form, if you took the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action, you can engage in Double- or Two-Weapon Fighting.

Until the end of your next turn, you can use Wisdom or Charisma instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls of your melee weapon attacks. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Shien Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: Before the end of your next turn, you can add half your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of +1) to your AC against one attack.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Shii-Cho Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: As a part of the {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to adopt this form, if you took the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action, you can engage in Double- or Two-Weapon Fighting.

Additionally, the first time you hit a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of you with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} before the end of your next turn, you can force the target to make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your bonus to attacks with the weapon). On a failed save, it is pushed back 5 feet, and you can immediately move into the space it just vacated without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Sokan Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: Until the start of your next turn, you ignore {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}. Additionally, when a hostile creature makes a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to move to another space within 5 feet of that creature without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}, imposing {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the triggering roll.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Soresu Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: The first time you take kinetic, energy, or ion damage from a weapon before the end of your next turn, that damage is reduced by half.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Trakata Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: As a part of the {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to adopt this form, you can {@optfeature Flourish|sw5e-phb|flourish} your weapon to attempt to distract an enemy you can see. Make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) or Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) check (your choice) contested by a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check of one creature that you can see within 5 feet of you. On a success, that creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the next {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} it makes against you.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Trispzest Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: Once before the start of your next turn, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against a creature that is {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb} of you.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Twilight Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: As a part of the {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to adopt this form, you can mask yourself with the force to attempt to hide from an enemy you can see. Make a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) check contested by a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check of one creature that you can see within 5 feet of you. On a success, you become {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} to that creature until the start of your next turn, or until you attack, cast a power, or otherwise take a hostile action against it.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Vaapad Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: Once before the start of your next turn, if you would have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can choose to forgo the {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. If you do so, you can make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against the same target (no action required), also without {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Vonil Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: If you took the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action before adopting this form, you can direct one of your allies to strike a creature you hit with an attack. Choose a friendly creature that can see or hear you and is within 5 feet of the creature you hit with an attack. That creature can immediately use its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} against the same creature.

optionalfeature.name: {@optfeature Ysannanite Form|sw5e-phb}
entries: As a part of the {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to adopt this form, if you took the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action, you can engage in Double- or Two-Weapon Fighting.

Additionally, until the end of your next turn, when making a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} while you are within 5 feet of a hostile creature, you do not have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}.
